svg.title: Sensor Array Jumper Placement
svg.desc: Rear jumper positions for 3-sensor and 5-sensor array configurations.
svg.text: Sensor Array Jumper Placement
rear jumper positions for 3-sensor and 5-sensor array configurations
Move both jumpers on the back of the board to select either
the 3-sensor layout or the 5-sensor layout.
3-SENSOR CONFIGURATION
Set both jumpers for the 3-sensor array
This position enables the 3-sensor layout used for right, front, and left sensing.
3-SENSOR ARRAY
What this setting does
• Use this jumper position when you want the board to operate
as a 3-sensor array.
• Set both jumpers to match this photo.
5-SENSOR CONFIGURATION
Set both jumpers for the 5-sensor array
This position enables the full 5-sensor layout with all five sensing locations active.
5-SENSOR ARRAY
What this setting does
• Use this jumper position when you want the board to operate
as a 5-sensor array.
• Set both jumpers to match this photo.
i
Tip:
Always move both jumpers together so the board stays in the same array mode on both sides.
Match the jumper placement exactly to the configuration you want before installing or using the sensor array.
